g.text: FERROSTATS — END-TO-END CLOUD DATA ENGINEERING ARCHITECTURE
Upstream OLTP Event Producer • Async Streaming Ingestion • BigQuery Medallion Lakehouse (Bronze / Silver / Gold) • Dataform SQLX • Looker Studio BI
Python 3.12 • BigQuery Storage Write • Dataform SQLX • Window SQL • Looker Studio
• Atomic stock deduction & Kárdex ledger write
• Pessimistic lock triggers async BQ stream
• Appends immutable Kárdex audit trail rows
• Real-time Burn Rate & stock threshold validation
SQLite WAL BEGIN IMMEDIATE + UUID Idempotency
• Zero heavy SDK bloat (native REST OAuth2)
• Zero latency impact on OLTP checkout (<50ms)
• Idempotent runs synced via Dataform API v1beta1
• Joins line items with header date & cost
SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) / Total
• Capital Tied Up & Potential Stock Value
• Daily grain by Category, Aisle & Payment
• Powers Star Schema joins in Looker Studio
• Burn Rate vs. Days of Inventory
FastAPI commits ACID sales in <35ms and offloads BigQuery
ingestion to asynchronous workers without blocking POS cashiers.
Handles at-least-once streaming retries via analytical windowing:
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY ingested_at DESC) = 1
Computes cumulative revenue share, ABC class, 30-day Burn Rate,
and Days of Inventory Remaining directly in BigQuery Gold SQLX.
& clustered Gold tables keep total cloud footprint at $0.00/mo.
